entities.summary: Marie Louise Marguerite Belèze (1851-1913), also credited as Marguerite Belèze, was a French botanist, taxonomist, and explorer. She collected extensive botanical collections, and is known for her work on the cryptogamic flora surrounding Paris. Some of her plant collections are held at the University of Strasbourg's Herbarium
